name: Acme_PolicyHook
author: Acme (example)
description: Reference daemon plugin (DAEMON-PLUGINS-2): a tool (acme_policy_check) that asks the daemon's policy for a frame's action and refusal, and a frameGate hook that counts frames by action kind. Never refuses anything itself. Copy it as a community module.

tools.name: acme_policy_check
tools.description: Reports the policy action of a frame type, whether the active preset refuses it, and how many frames of each kind the daemon saw.
